title: Lorrgs Midnight 12.1 boss ability icons and descriptions

scope.selection: All boss ability records exposed by Lorrgs for its current Midnight Season 2 raids, including records hidden by default.
scope.difficulty: The Lorrgs spell catalogue is shared; these records are not a separately verified Mythic tuning dataset.
scope.completeness: Complete for the retrieved Lorrgs catalogue, not every ability in the in-game encounter journal.
scope.descriptions: Concise paraphrases of the linked game-spell tooltips; unscaled mechanics, not damage-tuning reference values. Lorrgs returned empty inline descriptions for all selected records.

field_conventions.icon_file: Relative to the directory containing this JSON; preserve the icons subdirectory when moving files.
field_conventions.display_duration_seconds: Lorrgs timeline display configuration, not a verified spell-effect duration.
field_conventions.configured_cooldown_seconds: Lorrgs display configuration; zero does not mean the boss can cast continuously or has no cooldown.
field_conventions.shown_by_default: Lorrgs display preference, not an availability or difficulty flag.
field_conventions.description_spell_id: May differ from tracked spell_id if an otherwise empty cast record links to a documented mechanic record; this is explicitly flagged.

abilities.name: Soul Transfer
abilities.description: Jawae channels an essence transfer into an echo; the completion blast damages players caught nearby.

abilities.name: Ritual of Awakening
abilities.description: At half health, Nek'zali becomes protected by Jawae's tethers. Breaking every tether ends the protection and brings her back into the fight.

description_source.notes: Lorrgs tracks the 1295124 cast, whose tooltip has no descriptive text. The description comes from the same-named mechanic record 1289683; the icon and tracked spell ID remain those selected by Lorrgs.

abilities.name: Soulcoil Ignition
abilities.description: A four-second channel repeatedly invokes the Soulcoil Rite and releases Anguished Echoes from the well.

abilities.name: Invoke
abilities.description: Triggers the Soulcoil Rite and instructs Latent Cultists to carry out Entwined Step.

abilities.name: Possession Barrage
abilities.description: Spectral projectiles travel toward the primary target and cause raid-wide Shadow damage on impact. Longer travel distance reduces the damage.

abilities.name: Shifting Protovenom
abilities.description: A venom debuff periodically damages selected players. Contact between two contaminated players neutralizes it; touching an unaffected player instead causes an eruption.

abilities.name: Vitriolic Stasis
abilities.description: At full energy, the sentinels converge for 30 seconds, gain heavy damage reduction, and heal the weaker sentinel until their health matches.

abilities.name: Bloodvenom Injection
abilities.description: A tank strike combines immediate Physical damage with a long, stacking Shadow damage-over-time effect.

abilities.name: Unstable Miasma
abilities.description: A marked player detonates after a delay. Nearby players share the Shadow damage and receive applications of Clinging Murk.

abilities.name: Blighted Blood
abilities.description: Applies a Shadow damage-over-time effect to players, ticking throughout an 18-second window.

abilities.name: Empowering Slam
abilities.description: A heavy tank hit increases the golem's Physical damage when repeated on the same target. Striking a different target ends that escalation.

abilities.name: Toxic Droplets
abilities.description: Drops toxic objects that explode if left alone. Players can step on them to destroy them early, taking Nature damage.

abilities.name: Venom Coagulation
abilities.description: Creates a mass of venom that becomes a living slime add.

abilities.name: Malignant Catalyst
abilities.description: Vashnik detonates a venom orb, causing raid-wide Nature damage and releasing Catalytic Bile.

abilities.name: Imbibe
abilities.description: Vashnik draws power from two fountains and gains Toxic Vapor. The fountains release toxins and living venom adds that move toward the cavity.

abilities.name: Dripping Fangs
abilities.description: A heavy Physical tank hit adds a long Nature damage-over-time effect and a stacking increase to Physical damage taken.

abilities.name: Final Ascension
abilities.description: A prolonged ascension channel deals repeated Shadow damage to the entire raid.

abilities.name: Shell Spin
abilities.description: Launches three spinning shells in a cone. Players struck by a shell are stunned.

abilities.name: Blink Nova
abilities.description: After preparing a teleport to a player's position, Iku releases raid-wide Arcane damage that decreases with distance from that destination.

abilities.name: Shredding Shards
abilities.description: A rapid sequence of Frost hits targets one player; each shard increases damage taken from subsequent shards.

abilities.name: Mutilate
abilities.description: A frontal Nature attack divides its damage among those hit and applies Mutilated Gash. Too few participants make the strike lethal.

abilities.name: Dig In
abilities.description: Sszorak braces during Howling Maelstrom, creating a 25-second window in which he takes increased damage.

abilities.name: Venomous Surge
abilities.description: Selected players receive a venom damage-over-time effect. Its expiry creates a Viscous Cyst and a raid-damaging explosion whose damage falls with distance.

abilities.name: Raging Crosswinds
abilities.description: Wind debuffs deal periodic damage, then explode around their targets and knock them in marked directions, applying Turbulent Gusts.

abilities.name: Vile Flood
abilities.description: A sustained frontal stream of poison repeatedly deals Nature damage and applies Eternal Venom to players it hits.

abilities.name: Venomous Emergence
abilities.description: Summons Vexhul's offspring while damaging the raid and applying Eternal Venom.

abilities.name: Stir the Depths
abilities.description: A channel pulses Nature damage across the raid and creates traveling waves that damage players and apply Eternal Venom.

abilities.name: Caustic Deluge
abilities.description: A sustained toxin attack hits the current target and causes nearby acid impacts, which apply Eternal Venom and create Caustic Globules.

abilities.name: Stone Breaker
abilities.description: After pushing players back, Ithraz repeatedly strikes small areas. Hits apply stacking vulnerability; an unsoaked strike instead damages and knocks back the raid.

abilities.name: Rouse the Brood
abilities.description: Summons Broodlings of Ithraz and releases raid-wide Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Sanguine Storm
abilities.description: An 18-second shower of gore creates repeated small-area Shadow-damage impacts across the platform.

abilities.name: Ravenous Feast
abilities.description: Three successive shared Physical strikes consume Eternal Venom, apply Feasted, and knock players away. Insufficient participants cause the entire raid to suffer.

abilities.name: Coiling Ichor
abilities.description: Affected players carry shrinking areas of periodic Shadow damage that intensifies over time, leaving Congealed Gore when the effect ends.

abilities.name: Blood Torrent
abilities.description: A five-second attack repeatedly adds stacking healing absorption to its target and creates Barbed Bulwarks around Caustic Globules.

abilities.name: Fangs of the Coiled Altar
abilities.description: An eight-second channel repeatedly damages the raid, adds Twinfang Toxin stacks, and causes spreading hazardous ground beneath the altar's mouths.

abilities.name: Toxic Deluge
abilities.description: Venom impacts damage nearby players and leave Coalesced Venom behind.

abilities.name: Guillotine
abilities.description: A targeted axe impact shares Physical damage among nearby players and adds a strong vulnerability. Insufficient soaking triggers an execution; the axe later erupts.

abilities.name: Widow's Kiss
abilities.description: The axe releases a large-radius toxic explosion that deals Nature damage.

abilities.name: Venomfang
abilities.description: A poisoned axe passes between multiple players, leaving a Nature damage-over-time effect.

abilities.name: Axegrinder
abilities.description: Thrown axes damage and knock back players at landing points, then roam the arena as persistent Physical-damage hazards.

abilities.name: Sever
abilities.description: A frontal cleave applies a strong vulnerability to later Sever hits and destroys Coalesced Venoms and Virulent Mutations caught in its path.

abilities.name: Eternal Nightfall
abilities.description: Malacrass shields himself while preparing a devastating raid-wide Shadow attack. Break the shield to interrupt it; falling twilight also adds darkness stacks.

abilities.name: Dreadmarch
abilities.description: Possessed players gain a damage-absorption shield and walk toward a fatal fall. Removing the possession releases Manifestations of Dread.

abilities.name: Spiritcackle
abilities.description: Channels a summon that brings several Spiteful Soulcoilers into combat.

abilities.name: Gloombomb
abilities.description: Marked players explode after five seconds, damaging nearby allies and applying Gravebound to those struck.

abilities.name: Soul Sever
abilities.description: A frontal Shadow blast applies a damage-over-time effect, a strong vulnerability to repeat hits, and Gravebound; it also destroys Manifestations of Dread.

abilities.name: Soulbinding
abilities.description: Links Malacrass to Zul'jan, copies healing received by Zul'jan to Malacrass, and produces fragments that attempt to return to their host.

abilities.name: Defilement of the Coiled Altar
abilities.description: An eight-second altar channel applies raid-wide healing absorption, adds Corrupted Toxin stacks, and produces spreading Defiled Ground.

abilities.name: Grim Guillotine
abilities.description: A targeted axe shares Shadow damage among nearby players and applies healing absorption. Too few soakers cause a lethal alternative; the axe later erupts.

abilities.name: Blighted Sever
abilities.description: A frontal Shadow cleave applies Gravebound and a strong repeat-hit vulnerability while destroying venom objects and Manifestations of Dread in its path.

abilities.name: Caustic Waves
abilities.description: Moving venom waves deal immediate Nature damage and a stacking damage-over-time effect. Eggs struck by a wave hatch immediately.

abilities.name: Call of the Serpent
abilities.description: Spawn fall from above, dealing Nature damage around their landing points.

abilities.name: Spectral Coils
abilities.description: Spectral coils slam the platform for raid-wide Nature damage. More players near the impact reduce the resulting damage.

abilities.name: Mephitic Thrash
abilities.description: A tail sweep damages and knocks back nearby players; distant players instead take Nature damage followed by a damage-over-time effect.

abilities.name: Mother's Wrath
abilities.description: Ula'tek knocks back and attacks her marked target, applying Stone Venom and Hobbled. If that target stays out of reach, the effects hit everyone.

abilities.name: Rage of the Shackled
abilities.description: A 20-second rage repeatedly damages the raid, calls falling debris, and exposes the Venomous Heart.

abilities.name: Shadow Molt
abilities.description: The Doomscale Warden sheds its shadow skin and relocates.

abilities.name: Writhing Gestation
abilities.description: The Doomscale Warden converts nearby spawn into a clutch that hatches after a delay.

abilities.name: Grasping Fangs
abilities.description: Fangs attach to selected players, causing periodic Nature damage and slowing them until broken. Breaking a fang applies Blight Vein.

abilities.name: Venomous Heart
abilities.description: The exposed Venomous Heart takes doubled damage during a 20-second vulnerability window.

abilities.name: Defect: Weakened
abilities.description: Interrupting gestation leaves the Ravenous Doomscale taking doubled damage and prevents it from using Dread Roar.

abilities.name: Alluring Bubble
abilities.description: Forms a large water bubble that attracts nearby murlocs into it.

abilities.name: Pop!
abilities.description: The bubble bursts, dealing Frost damage across the raid and pushing players away.

abilities.name: Abyssal Rain
abilities.description: Four seconds of repeated Frost damage also leave a longer Frost damage-over-time effect on affected players.

abilities.name: Swirling Whirlpools
abilities.description: Whirlpools move toward the Alluring Bubble, heavily damaging anyone caught along their routes.

abilities.name: Chilling Frost
abilities.description: Repeated Frost hits slow affected players and leave Frost Orbs at their positions.

abilities.name: Iceblade Flurry
abilities.description: Repeatedly strikes the current target with Frost damage during a five-second attack sequence.

abilities.name: Water Jet
abilities.description: A sustained water jet damages and pushes players, clears icy ground, and applies a stacking vulnerability to subsequent Water Jet hits.
